page: Microsoft Azure M128-64bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by Microsoft Hyper-V. The system features 64 dedicated vCPUs derived from 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8473C processor running at 4.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It includes 105 MB of L3 cache alongside hardware support for vector and matrix acceleration instructions, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions). The instance provides 1024 GB of total system RAM, establishing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16 GB per vCPU. It lacks dedicated hardware GPUs and includes no local temporary storage, requiring reliance on remote block storage solutions.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional data throughput and parallel compute capacity. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 365.6 GB/sec, and write bandwidth achieves 173.16 GB/sec, placing memory throughput in the top ten percent of evaluated instances. Multi-core execution demonstrates consistent high output, highlighted by a multi-core stress-ng score of 67,520.07 and a PassMark CPU score of 81,783.6. In-memory data manipulation capabilities are pronounced, evidenced by a top-tier PassMark database operations metric of 35,206.66 and Redis SET throughput exceeding 87.5 million operations per second.

The absence of integrated local storage shifts all disk input and output to attached network block storage, creating an architectural dependency on network storage configuration for high-IOPS applications. However, the high memory density makes this instance structurally cost-efficient for workloads that eliminate storage bottlenecks through large in-memory footprints. The inclusion of Intel AMX extensions also enables CPU-based inference for moderate model architectures without requiring GPU hardware allocations.
The instance is suited for enterprise in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, large Redis deployments, distributed caching, massive analytical data processing, and large-scale compilation tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure M128-64bs_v3 is a memory-optimized instance engineered for large-footprint applications. Operating on the x86_64 architecture under Microsoft Hyper-V, the system is driven by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor with 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores clocked at 4.0 GHz, supported by 105 MB of L3 cache and AMX matrix instructions. It features 1024 GB of memory, delivering 16 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance contains zero GPUs and provides no integrated local disk storage, necessitating external network block storage for persistence. Synthetic benchmarks place its uncached memory bandwidth in the top tier, delivering 365.6 GB/sec read and 173.16 GB/sec write throughput, accompanied by top-tier database performance. This hardware balance suits large in-memory databases, real-time caching layers, and high-memory analytics.
